verdict.rationale: Notte documents a REST API in human-readable reference pages, including Bearer authentication and an agent-start endpoint, but there is no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on all of them. The llms.txt file, MCP server and CLI are adjacent agent-facing features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit here.
